mapper.select: SELECT s.warehouse_id,s.product_id,w.priority,s.stock_available AS available FROM inventory_warehouse_stock s JOIN inventory_warehouses w ON w.id=s.warehouse_id JOIN product_inventory p ON p.product_id=s.product_id WHERE w.enabled=TRUE AND p.catalog_lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND s.product_id IN #{product} ORDER BY s.product_id,s.warehouse_id FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_warehouse_stock (product_id,warehouse_id,stock_available,stock_reserved,stock_sold) SELECT #{productId},id,0,0,0 FROM inventory_warehouses WHERE id=#{warehouseId} AND enabled=TRUE ON CONFLICT (product_id,warehouse_id) DO UPDATE SET stock_available=inventory_warehouse_stock.stock_available
